about: Which of our folders feeds each Higgsfield preset. Our research and assets go in; Higgsfield does the production. hf_pack.py reads this file. state: built = hf_pack.py packs it today; mapped = the sources are named, the pack is not written yet; ours = our own tool does it, nothing is sent.
